gloss: to start laughing; to burst out laughing

definitions.gloss: to start laughing; to burst out laughing
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin laughing. The action of laughter starting, often implying a spontaneous or uncontrolled onset.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{急|きゅう}に{笑|わら}い{出|だ}した。
みんなが{一斉|いっせい}に{笑|わら}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Everyone started laughing all at once.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{顔|かお}を{見|み}たら、{笑|わら}い{出|だ}さずにはいられなかった。
examples.english: When I saw her face, I couldn't help but start laughing.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{突然|とつぜん}キャッキャと{笑|わら}い{出|だ}して、{周|まわ}りも{釣|つ}られて{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: The baby suddenly started giggling, and everyone around couldn't help but laugh along.

examples.japanese: {真面目|まじめ}な{会議|かいぎ}の{最中|さいちゅう}に{笑|わら}い{出|だ}しそうになって、{必死|ひっし}に{堪|こら}えた。
examples.english: I nearly burst out laughing in the middle of a serious meeting and desperately held it in.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す → {笑|わら}い{出|だ}さない (negative)
・{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す → {笑|わら}い{出|だ}して (te-form)
・{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す → {笑|わら}い{出|だ}した (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {笑|わら}う (to laugh) + {出|だ}す (to begin)

The ～{出|だ}す pattern attaches to the masu-stem of verbs to indicate the beginning of an action, often with the nuance of suddenness or spontaneity.

PATTERN:
{笑|わら}い{出|だ}さずにはいられない - can't help but start laughing

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
・{泣|な}き{出|だ}す - to start crying
・{走|はし}り{出|だ}す - to start running
・{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す - to start raining
・{話|はな}し{出|だ}す - to start talking
